files.content:
# The quarter in brief

We finished **14 projects** this quarter and billed **612 hours**, up from 11 projects and 540 hours last quarter.

Most of the work was websites: nine of the fourteen. Three were reports, and two were case studies written with
clients for their own sites. The median project took five weeks from first meeting to hand-over; the longest, the
Northgate Library annual report, took eleven, because the board asked for a second round of changes.

## What went well

- **Dates.** Twelve of the fourteen projects were handed over on the date we agreed. In our client interviews, all
  three clients named keeping to dates as the reason they come back.
- **Smaller, faster sites.** Every website this quarter was built as static pages, which kept hosting costs down and
  left nothing to patch.

## What we will change

- **Earlier client feedback.** Two projects ran late because the client saw the work for the first time near the
  end. Next quarter, every project has a check-in at the halfway point.
- **Telling clients sooner.** When a date is going to slip, the client hears it from us the same week.

## Next quarter

The new Fernhill & Co website goes live, with a case-study section. We expect around the same number of projects,
with more reports as clients plan their year-end.

---

*Draft by Writer, from the figures in figures/q3-summary.md. Charts to follow (QTR-4). For Reviewer to check (QTR-3).*
